title: Nano Ledger Viewport — Pricing Patterns & Token Attribution Export
creator: Asha Menon
description: Design a compact, scannable token-level cost viewport for the Redwood Console that supports fast attribution, role-aware CSV export, and pricing-pattern presets. The Nano Ledger Viewport is intended for engineers and finance analysts to debug token spend anomalies and to build chargeback CSVs for accounting teams. Deliverables: Figma prototype (three-pane), export spec (denormalized CSV and JSONL), accessibility pass, and handoff notes for ENG batching and sampling logic.
acceptance_criteria: Three-pane prototype implemented in Figma with responsive states (desktop/tablet)
Row-level attribution modal showing per-invocation token split, model variant, route, and prompt tags
Export button generates two canonical formats: denormalized CSV (one row per invocation slice) and compressed JSONL with token ranges
Pricing preset dropdown with three defaults (Developer, Production, Enterprise) and ability to save custom presets
Design annotations include privacy constraints and KMS-safe fields for private deployments
Design handoff document (Confluence) with acceptance QA checklist and engineering integration notes
design_notes: Overview: compact ledger header with aggregates (total tokens, cost today, 7d avg) + quick filters (route, model, env)
Primary canvas is a three-column layout: timeline sparkline + cohort filters (left), invocation list (center), detail pane (right)
Invocation list rows show condensed cost microbar (token composition: prompt/response/system), top prompt fingerprint, model variant badge, and latency KPI
Detail pane contains expandable sections: token lineage (prefix/KV cache hits), price breakdown by slab, attribution traces (parent request id), and downloadable CSV link for that slice

Export spec: CSV columns = invocation_id, timestamp, model, variant, route, user_id_hash, total_tokens, prompt_tokens, response_tokens, prompt_slices, token_cost_usd, pricing_preset, rollup_window_hour, dataset_tag
Sampling: when >1M invocations in range, UI defaults to stratified sampling (by route) and shows sample rate badge with CTA to run full export via background job
Privacy: user_id must be hashed and flagged; PII fields redacted in private deployments unless allowed by RBAC and KMS policy
Performance: design assumes server-side pre-aggregation for 1h buckets; ENG dependency to support tiled pagination and cursor-based streaming for long queries
Accessibility: ensure table rows keyboard-focusable, export button has descriptive aria-labels, color contrasts meet WCAG AA
decisions: Use denormalized CSV as primary export format to simplify downstream accounting imports (Decision on 2026-03-03)
Default time window presets will be: Last 24h, Last 7d, Last 30d to reduce cognitive overhead
Show estimated cost delta vs baseline on row hover to help surface anomalies
Enable role-aware exports: Finance role sees full cost columns, Developer role sees hashed user identifiers only
